method: Authored matched states in the archived May1 original canvas renderer and the actual shipped Arena; actual rendered settled camera and50/100/150ms movement/growth. Not a live original match or a current2026 renderer claim.
network: Original normal bootstrap and parser run through a fake WebSocket; CSP connect-src none; no original assets/fonts/skins loaded.
scope: Personal arena camera, cell geometry, centered names on every piece, food and grid. HUD/native controls are verified separately in the actual controller.
